records.name: event.track.tag.category.view.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form string="Track Tag Category">
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <field name="name"/>
                        <field name="tag_ids" context="{'default_category_id': id}">
                            <list string="Tags" editable="bottom">
                                <field name="sequence" widget="handle"/>
                                <field name="name"/>
                                <field name="color" widget="color_picker"/>
                            </list>
                        </field>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
            </form>
        </field>

records.name: event.track.tag.category.view.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list string="Track Tags Category">
                <field name="sequence" widget="handle"/>
                <field name="name"/>
                <field name="tag_ids" widget="many2many_tags" options="{'color_field': 'color'}"/>
            </list>
        </field>
